Rowland O'Connor

Cornish Independent Nonaligned GroupSt Columb Major, St Mawgan & St Wenn
cllr.rowland.oconnor@cornwall.gov.uk7732079611
RSS FeedReport CardCompare

Rowland O’Connor serves as a councillor for the St Columb Major, St Mawgan & St Wenn ward on Cornwall Council, representing the Cornish Independent Nonaligned Group. He sits on a range of committees, including the Audit Committee; the Budget Development Overview and Scrutiny Committee; the Chief Officers Employment Committee; the Constitution and Governance Committee; the Cornwall Council as a whole; the Corporate Finance and Performance Overview and Scrutiny Committee; the Miscellaneous Licensing Committee; the Standards Committee; and the Urgent Driver/Operator/Vehicle Sub‑Committee.

During the most recent reporting period, O’Connor attended 29 of 32 council meetings, giving him an attendance rate of 90.6 %. The data records zero conduct cases against him and no expense information is available. One active red‑flag indicator is noted as “slim_majority,” while there have been no media mentions. In the latest election, he was re‑elected with 546 votes, a majority of 57 votes (3.43 %) over the Liberal Democrat candidate, in a turnout of 34.57 % across a four‑candidate field, yielding an election‑vulnerability score of 64 out of 100.

Election History

CompetitiveScore: 64/100→ Stable
Won by 57 votes (3.4%)1.7% swing needed to unseat

Rowland O’Connor was re‑elected with 546 votes, a majority of 57 votes (3.43%) over the Liberal Democrat candidate, in a turnout of 34.57% and a four‑candidate field. The margin has narrowed by 6.3 percentage points since the previous election and a swing of roughly 1.72% would be sufficient to overturn the result, giving the seat a vulnerability score of 64 out of 100 (competitive).
